`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- Each variant's profile only adds permissions to the baseline. So a negative case that is denied in the full root+map+cryptex variant must also be denied in every smaller one, and checking the fixture against the union of grants covers all eight variants.
- `ensure_ascii=False` lowers the worst case for non-ASCII text (a 3-byte character no longer becomes a 6-byte `\uXXXX`). The largest report now comes from `\n`/`\t`, which `redact_stderr` keeps and JSON escapes, so that is the input the size test should use (N3).
- The baseline-reproduction requirement works as an A/B check. If the hosted runner stops aborting, the matrix reports a failure rather than crediting a factor with a fix it didn't make.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
